summary: Tested file download and preview features in chat. All 8 backend API tests pass. Frontend tests pass - FilePreview component correctly renders image previews, audio players, video players, PDF iframes, and generic file badges with download buttons. Blob download bypasses cross-origin restrictions.
critical_code_review_comments: Code correctly implements all requested file download and preview features:
- Backend: GET /api/chat/files/{file_id} returns file with correct MIME type using mimetypes module
- Backend: GET /api/chat/files/{file_id}?download=1 returns Content-Disposition: attachment header
- Frontend: FilePreview component handles image, PDF, video, audio, and generic files
- Frontend: Images show inline preview with click-to-open and download button
- Frontend: PDFs show iframe preview with download button
- Frontend: Videos show native video player with controls
- Frontend: Audio files show native audio player with controls
- Frontend: Generic files show extension badge with filename, size, and download button
- Frontend: Download uses fetch+blob to bypass cross-origin restrictions (handleDownload function)
- File upload still works correctly via POST /api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/upload
seed_data_creation: Used existing chat files in /app/backend/uploads/chat/: chatfile_4be1eb1c.jpeg, chatfile_1a8897fc.txt, chatfile_2cc4cba9.png, voice_79404088.webm
context_for_next_testing_agent: File download and preview features are fully functional. Lisa Schmidt conversation has image files that demonstrate the new preview functionality. The FilePreview component in ChatPage.js (lines 87-208) handles all file types correctly.
